thread:
alex: FYI seeing a sudden jump in fncall validator rejects for the new gpu-canary slice. Went from 0.05% -> ~3.8% around 11:03 UTC. Opening thread.
priya: Is this the structured output validator or the function-invoke post-parse? Any sample error?
dan: Looks like structured fncall validator. Error lines: "validation_error: expected object but got array". Small responses like ["done"] or ["ok"]. Appears concentrated on model variant rwd-gpu:canary-2026-04.
alert-bot: Alert: fncall_validation_rejects > 3% (5m) route=/v1/invoke region=eu-west-1 variant=rwd-gpu:canary-2026-04
priya: Repro snippet from logs (sanitized): ```{
  "route": "/v1/invoke",
  "variant": "rwd-gpu:canary-2026-04",
  "err": "type_mismatch",
  "exp": "object",
  "got": "array",
  "resp": ["ok"]
}```
alex: Two immediate choices: A) pause/revert canary slice B) add permissive fallback that coerces arrays->objects and continues traffic. B keeps signal but risks masking regression. Also billing + quotas get murky.
dan: If router rewrites to permissive we currently still attribute billing to the original strict slice. Billing team: thoughts on adding a route tag header so billing can reattribute?
billing: We can add x-rw-route-tag but it requires a small billing change (ingest + mapping table). Estimate 48h with backfill plan. For immediate fixes we can only pause or accept temporary mismatch in reports.
priya: Short-term safety: pause the canary, sample N failing responses (PII scrubbed) and make a dashboard tile: "fncall rejects by variant (sample link)". Medium-term: add a route-tag header and a console toggle to exclude canary-window rejects from billing alerts.
console-bot: Suggestion: create temporary panel: "fncall rejects by variant" and an action to fetch 200 scrubbed samples. Want me to scaffold the panel? :robot_face:
alex: Yes create panel + sampling. Dan please add a scrubber and push samples to s3://redwood-samples/canary/1801010101/ with TTL 7d. Priya please pause the canary. I'll open ENG-2210 to track followups: header change, console toggle, and postmortem.
dan: Started sampling pipeline. Scrubber removes emails, tokens, and long text. Writing samples now.
priya: Pausing canary (10% -> 0%) and routing back to rwd-gpu:stable-2026-03. Monitoring.
alex: Monitor reject rate. If it returns to baseline we keep canary paused and wait for model-team fix + compatibility test. Also add an internal flag to suppress billing alerts for trials in the future (opt-in, auditable).
billing: noted. Will draft header spec and flag handling, will attach to ENG-2210.
alert-bot: Monitoring: rejects falling back to baseline after pause.
alex: Thanks all. We'll keep samples for model team and reconvene after a fix. :thumbsup:
